newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS upgrades United Dominion notes to BBB.
newsitem.headline: DBRS upgrades United Dominion notes to BBB.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Friday that it had uprgraded senior notes of United Dominion Industries Ltd to BBB (high) from BBB, with a stable trend.
DBRS cited the company's growing profitability, favorable balance sheet and improved business mix of diversified products and geographical markets as the reasons for the upgrade.
"The company's financial profile has strengthened considerably during the last few years," DBRS added.
DBRS, however, warned that United Dominion's acquisition-based growth strategy could put pressure on the company's balance sheet.
